svg.title: Mockup 09: Releases, the channel, the hold and the event's tested release
svg.text: 09 · Releases: what the platform runs, what each event tested, and when it may change (superadmin, organiser)
Use case: Saturday evening, Demo Event is live and a fix merged on Friday waits. D10, D11, D12, E11. Tags v0.<step>.<n> exist today (docs/ci.md, Releases).
Superadmin · 1280 px at 85 %

g.text: The platform follows one channel. Events record the release they tested.
Demo Event is live until Sun 23:59
Nothing new reaches this platform while Demo Event is live. When the hold ends (Mon
23 Nov 06:00) the stack stays on stable; a maintainer promotes v0.10.6 after its own drill.

svg.text: Organiser: one line, no choices to make

g.text: The platform runs it now. Updates wait until your
Recorded in your event profile as platform.version. To
test a newer release, ask the superadmin.

svg.text: One channel for the stack (D10)
dev follows main on the test VM; stable moves
only when a maintainer promotes a tag that passed
its upgrade test and a restore drill.
The deploy hold (D12)
While any event is live, deploys wait. A hotfix is the
one exception: a maintainer marks it, a backup runs
first, the rollback stays as built (E11).
Which events tested which tag
Each event's profile records platform.version;
Readiness checks the stack runs it (mockup 02).
Versions stay v0.<step>.<n> until the switch, then
A queued deploy
Shown, not hidden: the organiser of the next event
can see what will change before they test.
